title.description: Document title exactly as it appears on the cover/first page (e.g. 'Microsoft Fiscal Year 2024 Second Quarter Results' or 'IMF Article IV Consultation — Staff Report: Japan 2024').

issuer.description: For Family A: the issuing company (e.g. 'JPMorgan Chase & Co.'). For Family B: the issuing institution (e.g. 'International Monetary Fund', 'European Central Bank').

family.description: A = corporate disclosure; B = macro flagship. Copy from ./_case_meta.json.

reporting_period.description: For Family A: the fiscal period (e.g. '1Q20', 'FY2024 Q2'). For Family B: the edition/date (e.g. 'April 2024', 'Vol 2025 Issue 1').

pdf_pages.description: Total page count of the source PDF.

page_count_range.description: [min, max] target slide count for the deck. Default [15, 20] to match PPTSynth economics gold; pick within [10,24] based on document depth.

central_thesis.description: One or two sentences: what the document reports and its headline message. For A: the quarter's performance narrative and its main driver. For B: the growth/inflation assessment and its main policy implication. Avoid vague verbs like 'discusses'.

ordered_sections.description: Ordered slide sections that become Section 1 of instructions.md. Follow the family section template from the Domain Context, adapted to the actual document. Must start with a title section and end with a closing/conclusion section.

title.description: Document-specific heading, e.g. 'Segment Performance: Intelligent Cloud' — not the generic word 'Segments'.

bullets.description: For non-title sections: 2-5 short bullets in 'Label: qualitative claim' form, each <=25 words, describing WHAT TOPIC the slide must cover and the qualitative framing — NOT the answer values. Bullets must be document-specific at the metric-name / segment / region / theme level so they cannot be swapped into another document unchanged. Bullets must NOT include: specific monetary values ($X billion/million), percentages, growth rates, basis points, EPS/ratio values, or the verbatim correct_form of any trap. Those live exclusively in key_numbers / key_terms / traps and flow only to the Stage 3 rubric — the slide-generating model must retrieve them from the PDF. For the title section: provide exactly four bullets 'Report Title: ...', 'Issuer: ...', 'Reporting Period: ...', 'Publication Date: ...'. For an outline section: empty array.

design_constraint.description: Optional. Name WHICH table/chart/exhibit the slide must present and WHAT TOPIC it shows — never a specific value. Form: 'Present a table comparing <segments/regions> on <metrics topically>' or 'Include the <named exhibit> showing <topical description>'. Do NOT embed specific monetary values, percentages, or growth rates — those are answers the slide model must retrieve. At least 3 sections in the deck must carry a design_constraint.

key_numbers.description: Quantities the deck must report accurately. Each is a self-contained anchor for a correctness checklist item. Number-dense finance documents should yield many.

claim.description: Full claim WITH value, unit, GAAP/non-GAAP or real/nominal label where relevant, and period/region, e.g. 'GAAP revenue of $62.0 billion for FY2024 Q2, up 18% year-over-year' or 'real GDP growth projected at 1.7% for 2024 (baseline)'.

paper_anchor.description: Where this came from, e.g. 'income statement, page 3', 'Table 1', 'Exhibit 4'.

key_figures.description: Tables, charts, or numbered exhibits that must be reproduced or cited in the deck.

id.description: As labeled in the document, e.g. 'Exhibit 3', 'Segment Table', 'GDP Projections Table', 'page 4 chart'.

intended_slide.description: Which ordered_section this should appear on, by title or kind.

key_terms.description: Finance/econ terms the deck must use correctly (e.g. non-GAAP, constant currency, CET1, core inflation, baseline scenario). Each anchors a correctness item.

common_confusion.description: Optional. The plausible-but-wrong claim a careless deck might make (e.g. 'treats non-GAAP operating income as GAAP').

traps.description: Specific risks of inaccurate finance framing the deck must avoid. Used to generate the most discriminative correctness items. Choose kinds from the family trap catalogue in the Domain Context.

claim_to_avoid.description: The wrong claim to flag, in concrete words.

correct_form.description: The faithful form supported by the document.

language_note.description: Optional one-line note. The corpus is English; the output task is always English.

pages_read.description: Which pages were read, e.g. '1-12 + projection tables' or '1-6, 30-35'.
